buildCommand: cp -n .env.example .env 2>/dev/null || true; cp -n .env.example .env.dev 2>/dev/null || true; cp -n .env.example .env.prod 2>/dev/null || true; if [ ! -d "flutter" ]; then git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git --depth 1 -b stable flutter; fi && ./flutter/bin/flutter config --enable-web && ./flutter/bin/flutter build web --release
